nodes.label: O-CORE, O-CTX and O-IMP component origins

nodes.label: Per-claim protection and necessary pathway conditions

nodes.label: Planned domain reference harm trees

nodes.label: App-by-pathway applicability records

nodes.label: RQ1 coverage: all mentioned nodes and modalities

nodes.label: L-GEN generic misuse risk
nodes.description: Generic misuse without concrete consequence is separate from L-HRM; inference features alone do not establish harm.

nodes.label: K-DIS, K-TRK, K-INF and K-INC capabilities
nodes.description: Distinguishing, tracking/profiling, inference and incapability; sensitive data collection alone is not inference.

nodes.label: Seven Knabenhans harm categories
nodes.description: Economic, physical, psychological, autonomy/deprivation, discrimination, reputational and societal harm.

nodes.label: T-REL relationship harm tag
nodes.description: Citron/Solove relationship damage tagged alongside applicable harm category, never replacing category.

nodes.label: P-BRC, P-INC and P-NOT breach/incident details
nodes.description: P-BRC user consequences of exposure; P-INC concrete incident response; statutory notification promises only P-NOT.

nodes.label: RQ2 stance attached to named harm
nodes.description: A named L-HRM harm may have several stances; component/capability-only units have none; absence is not stance.

nodes.label: S-ACK, S-QUA, S-MIN, S-RSP and S-DEN
nodes.description: Acknowledged, qualified, minimised, responsibility shifted, denied/prevented. Qualification alone is not minimisation; record qualification target.

nodes.label: RQ3 technical measures and N-COM commitments
nodes.description: Technical controls include T-3RD/T-INF/T-DEV/T-ENC/T-ANO/T-SEC/T-OTH; nontechnical commitments separate as N-COM; record actor/data/outcome/conditions.

nodes.label: F-FLW/F-HRM and partial/scoped/absolute protection
nodes.description: Code data-flow versus harm-prevention framing and strength; partial protection does not imply all remaining risk is prevented.

nodes.label: C-MIS potential mismatch: human review only
nodes.description: Claim-scope tension requires explanation of unaddressed necessary conditions. Author only, never model; no judgement of actual deployed system safety.

nodes.label: C-REA broad reassurance without named substance
nodes.description: Broad safety language without measure, scope or consequence; not applied when specific checkable measure named.

nodes.label: Paragraph or coherent UI block with evidence spans

nodes.label: Ten-app blind validation and leakage prevention

nodes.label: Per-code precision, recall, Cohen kappa and Gwet AC1
nodes.description: Correct label/unit/span; score staged pipeline end-to-end, app detection and provider-resampled exploratory intervals. These are planned metrics, not results.

nodes.label: Prompt paraphrases, recoding and second human review
nodes.description: Two paraphrased prompts, hidden label-source adjudication, two-app recoding >=two weeks later, second coder/supervisor review for applicability/minimisation/mismatch.

nodes.label: Lexical and outside-hit missed-mention audit

nodes.label: v001 full iPhone App Store keyword collector

nodes.label: Fitness candidate-discovery run

nodes.label: CLI, importable collect function and offline reparse
nodes.description: CLI writes JSON file or stdout, progress to stderr. Import collect from app_store_search with v001 on Python import path. --api-only skips pages. --reparse verifies hashes and rebuilds page fields offline, recording source JSON and parser hashes; also recovers interrupted checkpoints if every pending response was archived.

nodes.label: Raw evidence, provenance and snapshot protection
nodes.description: Existing snapshots protected against overwrite. Raw response bodies and HTTP metadata preserve attempts, dates, URLs and SHA-256 hashes. Absolute archive paths need explicit updates if moved; raw study files ignored by Git require backup.
nodes.rationale: Retain original response evidence and permit hash-verified reprocessing when page parsing changes.

nodes.label: Checkpointing and explicit partial collection status
nodes.description: JSON checkpointed as pages finish. Exit 0 completed, 1 collection/input failure, 2 saved results with page errors. Failed page retains app and API fields; collecting means interrupted checkpoint. Missing values null or empty lists. Atomic checkpoint saves retry transient Windows file locks; offline reparse can recover an interrupted checkpoint when every pending app response was archived successfully.

nodes.label: Apple public iTunes Search API
nodes.description: Search parameters media=software, entity=software, country=de, lang=en_us, explicit=Yes. Requested limit 1-200. No documented pagination here; fewer returned results do not establish complete keyword coverage.

nodes.label: Request pacing and retry behavior
nodes.description: Documentation records approximately 20 API calls/minute; client spaces API requests 3.2 seconds and page requests one second across workers. Retries transient failures, honors Retry-After up to 60 seconds and reports longer requested waits.

nodes.label: API position is not verified native store search rank
nodes.description: Original order retained without sorting by ratings; requested and actual counts recorded. API result position is not independently verified iPhone store rank, German popularity or downloads. Responses can vary over time.
nodes.rationale: Avoid claiming complete coverage or equivalence between API results and native storefront ranking.

nodes.label: Explicit iPhone support filter and preserved exclusions
nodes.description: supportedDevices must explicitly include iPhone. iPad-only, unknown compatibility, invalid records and duplicate IDs go to excluded_results with full API records and positions. This is a technical filter, not thesis eligibility.

nodes.label: Thesis eligibility remains unresolved by collector
nodes.description: Paid apps, native apps and apps without extracted policy links remain candidates. Script does not infer eligibility, invent downloads, select rating floor or freeze sample.

nodes.label: Product-page identity and storefront verification
nodes.description: Final URL, canonical URL when present and embedded page intent must match requested country and app identity. No silent storefront switch. English requested; actual HTML language retained, observed Germany redirect l=en to l=en-GB.

nodes.label: Embedded serialized-server-data parser
nodes.description: Public page structure is unversioned and can change. Explicit errors plus archived HTML support later reprocessing. No app download, login, device interaction or permission inspection.

nodes.label: Privacy disclosures and missing-link interpretation
nodes.description: Privacy labels are developer declarations, not independently tested behavior. Missing policy URL means parser did not find one in supported fields; it does not prove no policy exists. Linked policies and sites are not fetched.
nodes.rationale: Avoid converting listing declarations or extraction gaps into unsupported findings about app behavior or policy absence.

nodes.label: Complete API metadata retention
nodes.description: Identity, bundle/app IDs, developer/seller, description, classification, language/age, pricing, ratings, version/release metadata, device support, minimum iOS/file size, screenshots/artwork URLs, plus raw_api_data including unknown fields. Media not downloaded.

nodes.label: Public product-page enrichment
nodes.description: Public offer flags and subtitle, privacy/external links, privacy labels and details, purchase/subscription titles and prices, version history, compatibility/languages/provider details, page ratings and embedded reviews, JSON-LD and primary page content. Reviews are not exhaustive.

nodes.label: Primary-app data scope and raw-page preservation
nodes.description: product_page_data preserves primary product content including available accessibility/screenshots/shelves, omits analytics and related-app recommendations; original raw HTML preserves page evidence.

nodes.label: Offline collector verification coverage
nodes.description: unittest checks identity/storefront mismatches, unknown fields, missing values, iPhone filtering, API order, purchase/privacy/history extraction, page failures without losing candidates, HTTP retries, Windows file locks, checkpoint recovery and hash-verified offline reprocessing. Project checker also documented.

nodes.label: Interrupted checkpoint recovery and Windows lock retries
nodes.description: Offline reparse can recover an interrupted checkpoint only if every pending app response was archived successfully. Atomic checkpoint saves retry transient Windows file locks.

nodes.label: v001: Full product-page collector
nodes.description: Preserved full collector with product-page enrichment and tests.

nodes.label: v005: Current compact Apple-only sampling collector

nodes.label: Multiple keywords, storefront and requested limit

nodes.label: Timestamped keyword-mapped JSON output

nodes.label: Name-first selected listing and rating metadata

nodes.label: Original API position before iPhone filtering
nodes.description: Assigns API Position before iPhone filtering; retained apps stay in returned order. Position is not verified native iPhone App Store rank.

nodes.label: Repeated apps preserve per-keyword discovery
nodes.description: Repeated app IDs remain under every matching keyword, retaining cross-query discovery evidence.

nodes.label: Exact per-keyword request and capture provenance
nodes.description: Root region, requested language/limit and collection timestamp; per keyword exact request URL, capture time and returned count.

nodes.label: Observable signals without synthetic ranking or sampling decisions
nodes.description: Records observable listing/rating signals, not user preferences, impressions, exposure or downloads. No ranking score, eligibility threshold or final sample imposed. Requested API cap does not establish exhaustive coverage. Native-store first-N rules require separate UI capture.
nodes.rationale: Avoid conflating API observations with unmeasured user behavior, native ranking or final methodological decisions.

nodes.label: Unsupported developer type, download and review metrics omitted
nodes.description: API does not provide Dev. Type, Downloads, written Reviews or 2023 review counts. Seller provides developer identity without inferring individual/company type.

nodes.label: Ratings are not written-review or download counts
nodes.description: Rating Count counts ratings rather than written reviews or downloads. Does not reproduce Malki et al. preceding-12-month written-review measure.

nodes.label: Omit missing fields while retaining observed values
nodes.description: v005 omits missing/null values, retains actual zeros and observed empty lists. Uses Apple directly with no third-party estimate option.

nodes.label: Current data rather than reconstructed 2023 statistics
nodes.description: Captures current response data; does not reconstruct historical 2023 statistics.

nodes.label: Historical v004 public Sensor Tower monthly estimates
nodes.description: Historical option fetches public overview metadata per distinct app ID. Raw strings such as 100k-500k, 500k-1m and < 5k retained with source URL, retrieval timestamp and period Last month. No exact-number conversion; missing/failures omitted and stored in estimate_errors.

nodes.label: Historical v004 four-second pacing and HTTP429 guard
nodes.description: Estimate requests spaced four seconds; first HTTP429 stops estimates, records estimate_collection_stopped, retains all App Store candidates.

nodes.label: Historical estimate trial: 15 of 169 apps
nodes.description: Initial full fitness trial obtained 15 estimate ranges for 169 apps, with 154 HTTP429 errors; trial preceded stop-on-429 guard. Only partial bulk coverage observed.
nodes.rationale: Observed rate limiting means public pages are not established as a reliable bulk estimate source.

nodes.label: Third-party estimate scope limitations
nodes.description: Estimates are not Apple actual cumulative counts. UI card says worldwide; fetched metadata lacks geography and exact date boundaries, so neither asserted. country=US overview context and --region de do not make estimates German. Capture date is not provider refresh date. Unversioned wording can change; accuracy and bulk coverage unestablished. No final sampling choice.
nodes.rationale: Source metadata and partial trial cannot support German cumulative, precise-period or exact-download claims.

nodes.label: Appfigures plan-gated country/date estimates
nodes.description: API supports countries, start_date and end_date on select plans. Free tier announcement describes worldwide last-month snapshots, not free German cumulative totals.

nodes.label: Apple developer-account analytics reports
nodes.description: Reports available only for apps accessible via developer account and appropriate API-key role; not public competitor downloads.

nodes.label: Google Play sampling collector v001
nodes.description: Google Play counterpart of Apple collector reads Google directly using pinned open-source google-play-scraper; no commercial estimates or authenticated Developer API.

nodes.label: Direct public Google Play parsing
nodes.description: Pinned open-source parser reads Google public pages directly. No commercial estimate data or authenticated developer API used.

nodes.label: Isolated project environment
nodes.description: Project .venv and pinned v001 requirements installed from repository root. Future versions v002 etc. preserve prior source.

nodes.label: Keyword, storefront, language and requested limit
nodes.description: Accepts fitness or multiple keywords; defaults region de, language en, requested limit 200. Region identifies storefront context.

nodes.label: Timestamped per-version JSON output
nodes.description: Prints saved JSON path inside v001/output. Filename includes project, region, keywords and UTC timestamp.

nodes.label: Name-first app metadata
nodes.description: Package ID, genres, developer identity, release/update/version, install metrics, ratings/review counts/histogram, price/free/IAP/ads, advisories, listing text, screenshots/video, embedded review snippets and Google/developer/privacy policy links.

nodes.label: Disable synthetic defaults and preserve actual zeros
nodes.description: Missing fields omitted, observed zeros kept. Parser fallback values disabled so failed extraction cannot invent zero ratings, empty screenshot lists, false flags or version strings.
nodes.rationale: Distinguish extraction absence from observed data; preserve genuine zero-valued evidence.

nodes.label: Developer type and 2023 counts unavailable
nodes.description: Parser does not supply developer type or historical 2023 counts; omitted. Embedded review snippets are not a review corpus.

nodes.label: Original parser-returned search position
nodes.description: Original Search Position follows returned web-search order. Merged top-result/ordinary ordering is not verified native Android store rank; advertisements and organic entries not labeled.

nodes.label: Per-keyword repeated apps with cached details
nodes.description: Repeated packages remain under each keyword, preserving discovery context; details fetched only once per distinct package.

nodes.label: Detail failures preserve candidates
nodes.description: Failed detail fetch retains original search candidate and position; detail_errors stores failure.

nodes.label: HTTP capture evidence
nodes.description: Request metadata includes timestamps, requested/final URLs, status and response hashes.

nodes.label: No ranking score, eligibility or exhaustive coverage claims
nodes.description: No eligibility or ranking score imposed. Empty/fewer-than-requested results do not demonstrate exhaustive coverage. Parser uses one search response without pagination; no final study method chosen.
nodes.rationale: Returned parser order and a limited web response cannot establish completeness or final sample eligibility.

nodes.label: Local adapter for null top-result sections
nodes.description: Handles missing/null top-result sections that break pinned upstream search on current pages. Preserves upstream field mappings and stops after first ordinary grid.

nodes.label: Displayed install band and lower bound
nodes.description: Downloads is Google displayed install band, such as 100,000,000+, rather than precise downloads. Minimum Installs is band lower bound.

nodes.label: Raw embedded realInstalls field
nodes.description: Embedded Install Count copies Google page data field called realInstalls by library. Not a third-party estimate; counting definition/update cadence unestablished. Not labeled exact downloads, users or German installs.
nodes.rationale: Field provenance does not establish precise metric meaning or update timing.

nodes.label: Storefront context does not establish metric populations
nodes.description: Region is storefront context; rating, review and install fields cannot be assumed to describe identical geographic populations.

nodes.label: Listing review aggregate is not twelve-month reviews
nodes.description: Review Count is listing aggregate as returned, not preceding-12-month count. Embedded snippets do not create complete review corpus.

nodes.label: Upstream extraction code and prior audit
nodes.description: README links pinned search implementation, field mappings and prior project audit explaining extraction routes and limitations.

nodes.label: Restored TLS and strict country-preserving GET transport
nodes.description: Restores TLS factory after library import, replaces GET transport with certificate-verified requests, 30-second timeouts and one-second pacing. Rejects country-removing fallback and unexpected country/host redirects.

nodes.label: Version-specific positional extraction limits
nodes.description: Google page changes can break positional parser. Successful extraction does not independently validate metric meaning or app eligibility.
nodes.rationale: Parser execution and semantic validity are distinct; preserve uncertainty rather than resolving sampling decisions.
